title: picea mariana var. semiprostrata
intro: Picea mariana var. semiprostrata, commonly known as Black Spruce Dwarf, is a variety of Black Spruce tree that is native to Canada and is characterized by its compact growth habit. The essential oil extracted from its needles has been reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Picea mariana var. semiprostrata include reducing stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, particularly bornyl acetate, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
